columns.name: Trip ID
columns.description: A unique ID for each trip.

columns.name: Start Time
columns.description: When the trip started, rounded to the nearest hour.

columns.name: End Time
columns.description: When the trip ended, rounded to the nearest hour.

columns.name: Trip Distance
columns.description: Trip distance in meters. (Divide by 1609 for miles.)

columns.name: Start Community Area Number
columns.description: The Community Area number where the trip started.

columns.name: End Community Area Number
columns.description: The Community Area number where the trip ended.

columns.name: Start Community Area Name
columns.description: The Community Area name where the trip started.

columns.name: End Community Area Name
columns.description: The Community Area name where the trip ended.

columns.name: Start Centroid Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the center of the trip start Community Area. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: Start Centroid Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the center of the trip start Community Area. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: Start Centroid Location
columns.description: The location of the center of the trip start Community Area. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: End Centroid Latitude
columns.description: The latitude of the center of the trip end Community Area. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: End Centroid Longitude
columns.description: The longitude of the center of the trip end Community Area. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.

columns.name: End Centroid Location
columns.description: The location of the center of the trip end Community Area. This column will be blank for locations outside Chicago.
